summary: Millennium Group International Holdings Ltd filed a Form 6-K on June 25, 2026, announcing its unaudited financial results for the six months ended December 31, 2025. The filing contains routine financial disclosures including revenues of $10.9 million, a 23.3% decrease year-over-year, and gross profit of $1.2 million. There is no mention of any special situation such as an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, or other corporate event. This is a standard earnings release by a foreign private issuer, with no deal terms, board recommendations, or regulatory clocks. The filing is a routine periodic report and does not constitute a special situation.
